forces.title: Shift to immersive, experience-led travel across segments
forces.description: Travellers are increasingly seeking immersive, authentic, and meaningful experiences over conventional sightseeing. This shift impacts heritage, spiritual, and leisure tourism, with a growing demand for story-driven journeys, cultural engagement, and active participation. This necessitates a transformation in destination design, interpretation, and service delivery, moving from volume-driven visits to value-driven, personalized engagements for extended stays and higher spending.
forces.source_title: Heritage reimagined: Driving immersive, tech-enabled and experience-led tourism

forces.title: Expanding global wellness economy boosts fitness and wellness services
forces.description: The global wellness economy is experiencing robust growth, projected to expand approximately 8% annually through 2030, outstripping many discretionary categories. This creates significant tailwinds for the wellness segment, including gym memberships, fitness experiences, and wellness services. Consumers are expanding their definition of wellness beyond exercise, accelerating spending in adjacent categories and creating opportunities for brands to tailor offerings and build credibility in holistic wellness.
forces.source_title: As Wellness Spending Grows, Can Activewear Brands Seize the Opportunity?

forces.title: Live entertainment driving significant tourism and economic multipliers
forces.description: Large-scale live entertainment events, such as concerts, are emerging as powerful economic platforms, driving tourism, local business activity, and regional visibility. These events generate substantial direct and indirect economic impacts, attracting out-of-state and international visitors, increasing occupancy in hospitality, and boosting spending across transport, F&B, and local retail. They also facilitate spillover tourism to nearby attractions and create temporary employment, transforming episodic cultural moments into repeatable economic engines.
forces.source_title: The Assam report: Turning live music economy into a tourism multiplier

forces.title: Robust government policy and investment for tourism development
forces.description: Government initiatives such as Swadesh Darshan 2.0, PRASHAD, and Concert Tourism Policy, along with significant investments in infrastructure, are strengthening India's tourism ecosystem. These policies promote sustainable destination development, improve connectivity, enhance visitor experiences across thematic circuits (e.g., spiritual, heritage), and support event-led tourism. Strategic partnerships and viability gap funding further accelerate the transformation and competitiveness of the sector.
forces.source_title: From darshan to destination: The transformation of spiritual tourism in India

forces.title: Convergence of spirituality, culture, wellness, and leisure travel
forces.description: Spiritual tourism is evolving into an integrated experience economy, where spirituality converges with adjacent sectors like culture, wellness, and leisure. This structural shift transforms destinations into holistic ecosystems offering blended value propositions such as yoga retreats, Ayurveda therapies, and cultural programming. This redefines spiritual travel from a single-purpose activity to a multi-purpose journey, attracting diverse 'multi-dimensional spiritual travellers' seeking balance between faith, well-being, cultural immersion, and relaxation.
forces.source_title: From darshan to destination: The transformation of spiritual tourism in India

forces.title: Improved infrastructure and connectivity enhancing tourist accessibility
forces.description: Ongoing improvements in air routes, highway upgrades, intra-city mobility, and the development of dedicated tourism infrastructure (e.g., concert venues, lighthouse tourism sites, smart mobility) are significantly enhancing accessibility for tourists. This infrastructure development supports increased visitor flows, enables longer stays, facilitates regional travel circuits, and supports the expansion of leisure and business travel across India, acting as a crucial enabler for sector growth.
forces.source_title: The Assam report: Turning live music economy into a tourism multiplier

forces.title: Growing emphasis on sustainability and climate-conscious travel
forces.description: Travellers, especially Gen Z, increasingly prioritize authenticity and sustainability, viewing environmental responsibility as a baseline expectation. This structural shift drives demand for eco-friendly products and services and influences destination development, such as India’s first net-zero heritage circuit. This trend offers a competitive advantage for destinations demonstrating strong commitments to community engagement and responsible tourism practices, necessitating operators to integrate sustainable practices into their offerings.
forces.source_title: Heritage reimagined: Driving immersive, tech-enabled and experience-led tourism

forces.title: Digitalization and AI transforming travel discovery and experiences
forces.description: Digital platforms and Artificial Intelligence (AI) are playing an increasingly catalytic role in transforming how consumers discover, research, and engage with travel and wellness solutions. AI's ability to provide holistic guidance and personalized recommendations across products, advice, and training plans during high-intent life stages (e.g., weight-loss journeys, marathon training) creates significant opportunities. For travel agents and OTAs, digitalization helps improve operational processes and customer services, enhancing visitor experience and engagement.
forces.source_title: As Wellness Spending Grows, Can Activewear Brands Seize the Opportunity?

forces.title: Regulatory ban on money gaming impacts online gambling segment
forces.description: The ban on money gaming implemented in August 2025 led to a 17% decline in India's online gaming segment in 2025. This regulatory intervention poses a significant headwind and key risk for the Casino & Gaming sub-segment within Travel, Tourism & Leisure, specifically for online gambling platforms. While other forms of online gaming and in-app purchases in video games saw increases, the direct impact on money gaming activity indicates a challenging regulatory environment for this specific category.
forces.source_title: Media and Entertainment Industry In India

forces.title: Emergence and promotion of diverse niche tourism segments
forces.description: The growth and active promotion of niche tourism segments such as rural, eco-nature, luxury, medical, adventure, lighthouse, camping, and cruise tourism is a significant upside driver. These segments diversify India's tourism portfolio, attracting varied global and domestic traveler segments, and expanding the overall market. Government initiatives like developing lighthouse tourism and promoting specific thematic circuits further contribute to these segments' growth, unlocking new experiences and revenue streams for operators.
forces.source_title: Tourism And Hospitality Industry In India

forces.title: Strong domestic tourism serving as growth cornerstone
forces.description: Domestic tourism remains the cornerstone of India's hospitality and travel growth, contributing nearly 88% of total tourism spending. Fueled by younger demographics, higher disposable incomes, and a post-pandemic preference for local exploration, domestic visitor spending is significantly increasing. Urban Indians increasingly prefer shorter, experience-led breaks like wellness and adventure tourism, expanding new markets in Tier-II and Tier-III cities and driving infrastructure development, providing a stable and growing base for IN040303.
forces.source_title: Tourism And Hospitality Industry In India

viewpoints.title: Wellness economy's resilience and growth drives activewear and adjacent services
viewpoints.description: The global wellness economy is projected to grow by approximately 8% annually through 2030, significantly outpacing many discretionary categories. This robust growth creates powerful tailwinds not just for athletic apparel, but also for adjacent categories like gym memberships, fitness experiences, and wellness services. Brands have a clear opportunity to capitalize by engaging consumers at key life stages and integrating into evolving wellness routines, indicating a sustained positive outlook for the wellness segment within consumer services.
viewpoints.source_title: As Wellness Spending Grows, Can Activewear Brands Seize the Opportunity?

viewpoints.title: Heritage tourism transforming into economic catalyst for India
viewpoints.description: India's rich heritage is increasingly recognized as a powerful catalyst for sustainable development, cultural preservation, and economic growth within the tourism sector. This transformation is driven by evolving traveler expectations for immersive, authentic, and tech-enabled experiences, moving beyond traditional sightseeing. Unlocking this potential requires integrated approaches combining digital innovation, visitor engagement, and sustainable practices, positioning heritage tourism as a key growth driver for the country.
viewpoints.source_title: Heritage reimagined: Driving immersive, tech-enabled and experience-led tourism

viewpoints.title: Live entertainment serves as significant tourism multiplier for emerging cities
viewpoints.description: Live entertainment, particularly large-format concerts, is increasingly serving as a scalable economic platform that drives tourism, activates local businesses, and enhances regional visibility across India. These events generate significant economic impacts extending beyond ticket sales, benefiting hospitality, transport, retail, and F&B sectors. Proactive policy, infrastructure readiness, and public-private partnerships are crucial to institutionalize live entertainment as a repeatable and durable engine of regional economic growth and tourism development.
viewpoints.source_title: The Assam report: Turning live music economy into a tourism multiplier

viewpoints.title: Spiritual tourism poised to be a key pillar of India's growth story
viewpoints.description: India’s spiritual tourism sector is undergoing a remarkable transformation, shifting from a pilgrimage-centric activity to a powerful driver of cultural preservation, destination development, and economic growth. With rising domestic travel and a preference for experience-led journeys, it has the potential to become one of the most impactful pillars of India’s tourism growth story. This evolution combines economic value creation with cultural conservation, promoting inclusive development and enhancing India's global soft power.
viewpoints.source_title: From darshan to destination: The transformation of spiritual tourism in India

viewpoints.title: Spiritual tourism shifting to value-driven, experience-led ecosystem
viewpoints.description: India's spiritual tourism landscape is transitioning from a volume-driven model focused on ritual completion to a value-driven ecosystem, where experience differentiation is central to competitiveness. Travelers are increasingly seeking depth, meaning, and engagement over mere access to sacred sites. This requires destinations to cater to diverse traveler archetypes with differentiated expectations, shaping experience design, length of stay, spending behavior, and engagement depth, leading to enhanced value capture.
viewpoints.source_title: From darshan to destination: The transformation of spiritual tourism in India

viewpoints.title: India's tourism & hospitality sector entering 'golden cycle' of sustained growth
viewpoints.description: India's tourism and hospitality sector is experiencing a 'golden cycle,' supported by sustained growth in average room rates, strong investment returns, and attractive valuations. The sector is poised for significant growth, with total contributions to GDP expected to nearly double by 2035 and employment projections reaching 64 million jobs. Robust domestic demand, increasing international visitor spending, and government policy support are key drivers, reinforcing a highly positive outlook for the industry.
viewpoints.source_title: Tourism And Hospitality Industry In India
